sourceNotes: 新增默认关闭的音频模块，支持系统音量、静音、输入输出设备切换及连接已配对蓝牙设备
新增显示器信息与外接屏 DDC/CI 控制
新增 xstats:// 深链，支持启动器调用页面、菜单栏详情、番茄钟与普通防休眠
菜单栏新增仅图标模式，只保留一个 XStats 入口，展开后查看所选指标
状态总览改为紧凑指标列表，点击原地展开详情，关闭后释放详情采样需求
AI 额度支持菜单栏进度条，蓝牙电量遵循文字显示样式，总览网络归属地遵循已有显示偏好
可选模块统一迁入功能设置页
菜单栏弹窗新增独立更新入口，发现新版本时可直接打开更新页面
修正 CPU 核心类型与分工描述，系统热压力仅在异常时突出提示，避免提示变化挤动温度和布局
修正风扇起步状态与零转速的展示，启动提示最多保留 10 秒，已有风扇转动时不再汇总显示启动中

en: Add an optional audio module, disabled by default, for system volume, mute, input/output switching and connecting paired Bluetooth devices; on macOS 14.4 or later, permission enables per-app volume (0–200%), mute and independent output, processed locally without recording or uploading audio
View display resolution, scaled resolution and refresh rate, and adjust external display brightness, contrast and volume when the hardware and connection support DDC/CI

Use xstats:// links from launchers to open pages and menu bar details, control the Pomodoro timer or start ordinary keep-awake; disabled modules lead to feature settings and are never enabled automatically
Choose the icon-only menu bar mode to keep a single XStats entry and view selected metrics when opened
Use a compact overview with details expanding inline; closing details releases their sampling demand, while network rates use a tighter layout and duplicate settings buttons are hidden
Show AI quota as a menu bar progress bar, apply the chosen text style to Bluetooth battery levels, and respect the existing network location preference in the overview
Manage processes, Pomodoro, AI usage, audio, cleanup and the menu bar calendar together in Feature Settings while preserving existing configuration
Open the update page directly from a dedicated menu bar popover button when a new version is available
Correct CPU core types and workload descriptions, and highlight abnormal system thermal pressure without shifting temperature values or the layout
Correct fan startup and zero-RPM display: startup hints last at most 10 seconds and the summary stops showing Starting once any fan is spinning
